turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. My son found out about a zero on his phone in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
Then get to it, Hale. I have a call at 4:40, and I'm still waiting for a name and a reason.
If you escalate this, I'll make sure the academic integrity committee sees everything, including his two late assignments from September.

"His two late assignments from September." You're threatening to pull in a separate matter if I ask for a review, and I'm writing that down word for word. The principal's office is my next stop either way.

It isn't my call, Hale, it's yours, and your own procedure says you contact me before any mark is entered and that software alone doesn't establish anything. Withdraw the zero today and confirm in writing that nothing is on his record. Otherwise I go upstairs when we're done here.
